services.name: Das Boot - Shared
services.desc: Search for a magical beer stein in Das Boot Haus! 1 hour About Your team is searching for “Das Boot”, a beer stein known for its ability to turn water into beer. In efforts to acquire such a rare commodity, you all decide you will do whatever it takes to steal “Das Boot.” Rumors say “Das Boot” is owned by the infamous Hans Schroder who has hidden it in his biergarten, Das Boot Haus. Do you have what it takes to outsmart Hans and get your hands on the legendary "Das Boot?" Capacity 3(recommended 4) to 8 players in a room (If you want to play with only 2 people, you can, but do 1 Hr • 3 (recommended 4) to 8 players • Ages 7+ • Seasonal pricing may vary
